newsitem.title: USA: Tupperware U.S. sales fall 13.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tupperware U.S. sales fall 13.2 pct.

text.p: Tupperware Corp said on Tuesday sales in the United States fell 13.2 percent in 1996.
The company attributed the drop to a smaller sales force, which it said was due to its transition to a non-stocking distributor model and higher sales force standards.

Earlier, the company reported fourth-quarter pro forma net income of $1.17 per share, up from $1.14 in the year-ago quarter. For the full year the company said pro forma net rose to $170.4 million, or $2.70 per share, from $2.55 per share.
Sales in Latin America rose 33.9 percent for the full year, but European operations fell 2.3 percent from the impact of unfavourable foreign exchange, the company said.
It said operations in Asia Pacific fell 4.8 percent because of unfavourable foreign exchange and softness in Japan and the Philippines.
